notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 (released 2026-10-07): successor to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 with a 1M-token context and up to 128K output. Base price $0.10 / $0.50 per MTok (cache read $0.01, write $0.125); the cost registry records the base rate only. Third-party sources also list a >100K-token prompt tier at $0.50 / $2.50 per MTok; not yet confirmed against Anthropic's pricing page, so it is not encoded. The backend skips output_config.effort for every haiku id, so effort is not sent to this model until its support is verified.
